lessons: 2026-10-05 SAM is the single gate in front of every federal sign buy. Three right-sized jobs were awarded in two weeks while it sat on the owner list for five weeks — a gate that blocks revenue goes to the top of the owner list, not the bottom.
2026-10-05 Read the set-aside before qualifying: IHS often uses Buy Indian set-asides, but 75H70626Q00230 is Total Small Business — B9 is eligible.
2026-10-05 County gateway ITBs bundle licensing, permitting and bonds. Fabrication capability alone does not make B9 eligible; decide the licensed-partner route once and reuse it.
